name: Nenya
game_text:
Bearer must be Galadriel.
At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.
flavor_text: “‘Verily it is in the land of Lórien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.’”
